case_name: Nirmal Kumar Mishra vs State Govt. of NCT of Delhi
withdrawal_location: Axis Bank ATM, Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh
network_pattern: ~Rs 1.92 crore credited into suspect Yes Bank account; transferred to ~50 layer-2 mule accounts; ATM/self-cheque withdrawals
cctv_or_location_evidence: ATM CCTV identified the alleged cash withdrawer; CDR/location evidence also recorded
notes: Complaint filed on NCRP on 2024-06-06; victim transferred Rs 17.07 lakh in 9 transactions to 7 bank accounts.

case_name: Dudhagara Rimpal vs State of NCT of Delhi & Anr.
incident_location: Complainant location not specified; linked account at Jalandhar, Punjab
withdrawal_location: ATM location not specified; linked HDFC branch in Kapurthala Road, Jalandhar
network_pattern: Rs 6 lakh sent to co-accused account; Rs 5.90 lakh withdrawn by self-cheque same day and Rs 10,000 via ATM next day
cctv_or_location_evidence: Bank-branch CCTV reportedly showed the cash withdrawal at branch
notes: Senior citizen transferred Rs 26.8 lakh between 2025-08-25 and 2025-09-03 after callers impersonated TRAI and Mumbai Crime Branch officials.

case_name: Churendra Verma vs State of Chhattisgarh
incident_location: Khairagarh, Chhattisgarh; victims across multiple States
withdrawal_period: Not specified; short period after credit
network_pattern: Three Bank of Maharashtra accounts identified as Layer-1 mule accounts; Rs 1.5935 crore credited to one account and Rs 1.572546 crore withdrawn
notes: Accounts/ATM cards/mobile numbers were allegedly procured and supplied to main accused.

case_name: Chizobam Krist @ vs State of Odisha
incident_location: Vasant Vihar, New Delhi; linked to Odisha investigation
network_pattern: Rs 2.7 crore allegedly deposited into nine Indian Bank accounts; many ATM withdrawals occurred from Vasant Vihar

notes: Court record alleges account-selling business and ATM cash withdrawals.

case_name: Monika Yadav vs State of Chhattisgarh
network_pattern: ~Rs 12.05 lakh credited through fraudulent online transactions; Rs 12 lakh withdrawn by cheque plus Rs 5,500 via ATM
notes: The account holder allegedly handed over withdrawn proceeds to a main accused.

case_name: Rohit Shobhwani vs State of Chhattisgarh
network_pattern: Rs 1.556 lakh suspected cyber-fraud proceeds transferred into the account; substantial amount later withdrawn
notes: FIR registered on 2025-07-14 based on information received from the Ministry of Home Affairs.

case_name: Sonu Wadhwani vs State of Chhattisgarh
withdrawal_period: Short span after credits (details not specified)
network_pattern: Rs 1.556 lakh and Rs 49,000 were reported as suspected cyber-fraud proceeds in separate linked accounts; related investigation also cites substantial credits and withdrawals
notes: Common-order matter covering multiple crime numbers; case linkage rather than a single victim loss figure.

case_name: Arbaz @ Dhoni S/O Iqbal Bhai Hasambhai Qureshi vs State of Gujarat

network_pattern: 12 bank accounts attributed to applicant and wife in case allegation; broader network grew from 52 to 61 accounts; proceeds withdrawn through ATMs/cheques and converted to cash, then routed via Angadiya/USDT
notes: The order states the total cyber-fraud amount deposited in implicated accounts was Rs 9.437 crore.

case_name: Narendra Maheshkumar Mali vs State of Gujarat
network_pattern: Applicant allegedly allowed SBI account to receive Rs 9.5 lakh, withdrew Rs 9.32 lakh and Rs 20,000 via ATM, and handed proceeds to co-accused

case_name: Lalaji Vishnuji Thakor vs State of Gujarat
network_pattern: Rs 6.91 crore allegedly defrauded; funds withdrawn through self-cheques, ATMs and online transactions
notes: Investigation followed a complaint via cybercrime helpline 1930.

case_name: Paul Onyeji Atuh vs The State NCT of Delhi
withdrawal_location: ATM locations not fully specified; CCTV showed cash withdrawal in Greater Noida context
network_pattern: SBI account received Rs 35.81 lakh from multiple people; deposits were withdrawn almost immediately through ATM on different dates or transferred electronically

case_name: Rajesh Kumar Sharma courier/customer-support cyber fraud

withdrawal_period: Investigation in 2022; exact ATM transaction date not stated
network_pattern: Rs 2.4 lakh transferred to five bank accounts; Rs 40,000 reached a Jharkhand account and was linked to ATM cash withdrawal
cctv_or_location_evidence: ATM CCTV + linked mobile-number analysis used by police
notes: Police recovered cash, debit cards, phones and cheque book; four arrests reported.

source_type: Gurgaon Police report via Times of India

source_type: Lucknow Police report via Hindustan Times
incident_location: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh; network linked to nearby towns/villages and overseas handlers

case_name: Sahil Khan vs State Govt. of NCT of Delhi
incident_location: Jharkhand, Mewat, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan; Jaipur specifically mentioned
fraud_type: Inter-state cyber fraud / mule-account cash withdrawal
withdrawal_location: ATM booths in Rajasthan and Bihar, including Jaipur
network_pattern: Fraud proceeds routed through multiple mule accounts across states followed by rapid ATM cash withdrawals
cctv_or_location_evidence: ATM CCTV plus CDR/cell-ID location charts used; alleged withdrawers identified
notes: Court described an organised inter-state cyber-fraud network with distinct roles for accounts, SIMs, routing and cash withdrawals.
